column3: With respect to the Aloft Chesapeake and Fairfield Inn & Suites Williamsburg Mortgage Loan (3.4%), the related borrower sponsor was the borrower sponsor of loan secured by a non-collateral hotel property located in Illinois, which entered monetary default in March 2021 due to COVID-19 impacts. A court-appointed receiver was put in place in July 2021 and the property was sold in July 2023.
